risk_summary: The excerpt presents a generally confident and favorable operating outlook, emphasizing record revenue, debt reduction, integration advantages, and anticipated policy-driven demand. It acknowledges material risks from steel-price volatility, recessionary demand, energy costs, supply-chain disruptions, and geopolitical events, but relies substantially on forward-looking expectations and optimistic assumptions. The abrupt truncation and insertion of unrelated guarantor and indenture disclosures reduce contextual clarity.
